title: Human Resource Manager
description: Company Description Hash Garments Factory PLC is a growing manufacturing company specializing in garment production for local and international markets. Located in Addis Ababa, the factory focuses on delivering quality products while maintaining efficient, safe, and compliant operations. The organization values its workforce and aims to create a fair, inclusive, and performance-driven work environment. As the company expands, it is strengthening its human resources function to support talent development, employee engagement, and organizational effectiveness. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Human Resource Manager role based in Addis Ababa. The Human Resource Manager will oversee the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and offboarding for factory and office staff. Responsibilities include developing and implementing HR policies, maintaining accurate employee records, managing attendance and payroll-related data in coordination with finance, and ensuring compliance with labor laws and internal regulations. The role involves leading employee relations initiatives, handling grievances and disciplinary matters, organizing training and development programs, and promoting a safe, respectful, and inclusive workplace. The Human Resource Manager will collaborate closely with senior leadership and line managers to align HR activities with business objectives and support continuous improvement in productivity and employee satisfaction. Qualifications Strong skills in recruitment, interviewing, and onboarding processes for diverse workforce levels. Proficiency in HR policy development, performance management, and employee relations, including grievance handling and disciplinary procedures. Experience with HR administration, including maintaining employee records, managing attendance, and supporting payroll and benefits processes. Knowledge of Ethiopian labor laws, workplace health and safety standards, and compliance practices in a manufacturing environment. Ability to design and deliver training, support career development, and foster an engaging, inclusive work culture. Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with management and staff. Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and confidentiality in handling sensitive information. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field; professional HR certification is an advantage. Prior HR management experience in manufacturing, industrial, or related sectors is highly desirable.

title: Executive Assistant - AI & Business Operations
description: Fully remote | Working directly with the CEO | Monthly compensation in USD About Us We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes. Job Description As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business. Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track. You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed. You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted. Key Responsibilities Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up. Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early. Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers. Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions. Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed. Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up. Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists. Support marketing initiatives by organising briefs, assets, deadlines and collaboration with internal and external contributors. Coordinate IT requests, access requirements, software subscriptions and communication with technical colleagues. Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible. Connect Microsoft tools with suitable AI skills and workflows, respecting permissions and confidentiality. Create, adapt and maintain AI skills and repeatable workflows for research, reporting, documentation and operational coordination. Check AI-generated work for accuracy, relevance and completeness before it is used. Keep business information organised and handle confidential matters with discretion. Required Qualifications Experience in executive assistance, business operations, project coordination or a comparable role involving substantial ownership. A working understanding of HR, finance, IT and marketing, sufficient to coordinate tasks, ask informed questions and recognise when specialist expertise is required. Strong practical experience with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Ability to organise collaboration across these tools, including shared documents, structured information, task tracking and access coordination. Confidence using Excel to maintain operational overviews, reconcile information and prepare clear reports. Practical experience creating or configuring reusable AI skills and applying them to real work. Ability to explain a workflow you personally implemented, including how you checked its results and handled its limitations. Strong prioritisation and follow-through, including the ability to manage several workstreams without constant reminders. Clear written and verbal communication in English. Confidence working with spreadsheets, documents, shared knowledge systems and task management tools. Sound judgement about confidentiality, access permissions and the information shared with AI tools. Willingness to take responsibility, resolve routine issues independently and escalate significant risks promptly. Resilience and adaptability in a startup environment, including changing priorities, incomplete information and periods of high workload.
